# Lastelle AI

> Lastelle AI Corporation is an artisanal AI workshop synthesizing agentic systems and AI-embedded hardware from human craft and machine intelligence. It was founded by Damien Rosecraft.

Source: https://lastelle.ai/
Last updated: 2026-11-01

## Intelligence synthesized by humans

Lastelle AI is an artisanal AI workshop, synthesizing agentic systems and AI-embedded hardware from human craft and machine intelligence.

## Products

Works in progress at the bench

### Anomaly Detection

An institutional-grade pipeline that watches the public markets of the technologies shaping this century, from the life sciences and energy to aerospace, robotics, and defense, and brings forward the movements that break from their expected pattern. Findings are designed to trace back to the records that produced them.

### Aerospace

Humanity still observes its own star system through a scattering of instruments. Lastelle's aerospace work begins with agentic systems that study published survey and mission data to map and rank resource-bearing bodies. From there it reaches toward a wider network of sensors and probes held in orbit around the planets, extending the sight and hearing of a civilization that has barely begun to look outward from its home.

### Hardware

Devices with intelligence embedded at the hardware level, designed to operate as one interoperable system and directed at problems in energy, telecommunications, search and rescue, and defense.

## Mission

For the acceleration of the human project

Lastelle AI synthesizes solutions at the confluence of human judgment and machine intelligence, where intuition and conviction lend direction to computation on a scale no single mind could hold. Each system is composed with the deliberation of the workshop and carried out with the reach of the frontier, so that what leaves the bench extends what people are able to build, understand, and become.

## About

Lastelle AI Corporation was founded by Damien Rosecraft, a technologist since 2016 who designs and builds Lastelle's systems

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/thirdechelon

## FAQ

### What does Lastelle AI build?

Agentic systems and AI-embedded hardware, designed and built in-house.

### Does Lastelle AI take client work?

Lastelle builds its own products. Partnership inquiries are welcome.

### What technology are the systems built on?

State-of-the-art solutions from the frontier.

### Where does the market data come from?

Verified market sources, with findings designed to trace back to their origin.

### How quickly will I hear back?

Typically within two business days.
